raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

On MI355X (gfx950, TP8), the entire Kimi-K3 KDA (Kimi Delta Attention) layer can run as a single fused Gluon op. This PR adds an in-tree backend that routes the KDA layer through the aiter fused ops, replacing an out-of-tree monkeypatch plugin with a clean, flag-gated path.

## What this does

New server arg **`--kimi-kda-fused-layer-backend {native, aiter}`** (default `native`, **no behavior change**):

- **`aiter`** — `KimiK3DeltaAttention.forward` routes the whole KDA layer through the aiter fused ops:
  - **Decode:** one kernel does the QKVG/beta-forget-A projections + conv + single-token gated-delta recurrence + gated RMSNorm + **fused O matmul**, and returns the rank-local O **partial** for the decoder-boundary TP reduce — exactly what `self.o_proj(core)[0]` returns in this config.
  - **Prefill:** the fused ragged-batch gated-delta core, then the native `o_proj` (which owns its TP reduction).
- **Fail-closed:** a static layer-config contract + the aiter op's `*_supported()` gate are checked per forward; any arch / shape / reduce-topology miss falls back to the native per-kernel KDA path. Off gfx950 / pre-3.8 Triton / without the aiter op, nothing changes.

Implementation leaves the native KDA path untouched: the fast path + two helpers on `KimiK3DeltaAttention`, two small public accessors on `KDAAttnBackend` (`fused_kda_layer_state`, `track_fused_decode_state`) that reuse the existing mamba caches and `_track_mamba_state_decode`, and the new arg. The fused prefill reuses the native `forward_qkvbfg_fused` projection instead of duplicating it.

## Dependency

Requires the aiter ops `aiter.ops.triton.kimi_delta_attn.kimi_kda_fused_layer_{prefill,decode}` (separate aiter PR). The backend engages when `do_fuse_qkvbfg` is active for the layer.

## Validation (Kimi-K3, TP8, MI355X gfx950)

- **Correctness:** GSM8K (1319-Q, 5-shot) = **0.978**; aiter ops are bit-identical to the reference kernels across all decode/prefill shapes.
- **Perf:** consistent whole-layer speedup over native (+6–9% tok/s across short/mid context; the decode dispatch routes by batch range to the two kernels that dominate an on-device bake-off, which also beats the per-size dispatch by up to ~20% tok/s at higher concurrency).
- **Default off = inert:** `native` reproduces stock numbers.

pre-commit (isort / ruff / ruff-format) clean.

+    def _forward_kda_fused_layer(self, hidden_states, forward_batch):
+        """Whole-layer fused KDA via the aiter Gluon ops (gfx950/MI355X TP8).
+
+        Returns the layer output when the aiter whole-layer kernels cover this
+        call, else ``None`` to fall back to the native per-kernel path. The
+        decode kernel fuses the O projection and returns the un-reduced o_proj
+        partial -- the decoder boundary reduces it exactly as the native
+        ``self.o_proj(core)[0]`` path would. Prefill returns the (m, 1536) gated
+        norm and applies the native ``o_proj`` (which owns its TP reduction).
+
+        Fail-closed: any arch / layer-config / shape / reduce-topology miss
+        returns ``None`` before the state pools are touched.
+        """
+        if not self._kda_fused_layer_aiter:
+            return None
+        # Static layer-config contract shared by prefill and decode, matching
+        # the whole-layer kernels' fixed TP8 shapes.
+        if not (
+            self.do_fuse_qkvbfg
+            and self.use_full_rank_gate
+            and self.attn_tp_size == 8
+            and self._bfa_w is not None
+            and not self.all_reduce_fusion
+            and tuple(self.split_sizes) == (4608, 1536)
+            and (self._bfa_fa_size, self._bfa_b_size) == (128, 12)
+            and self.attn.bias is None
+            and self.attn.lower_bound == -5.0
+            and self.o_norm.eps == 1e-5
+        ):
+            return None
+
+        from sglang.srt.layers.attention.hybrid_linear_attn_backend import (
+            HybridLinearAttnBackend,
+        )
+        from sglang.srt.layers.attention.linear.kda_backend import KDAAttnBackend
+        from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_info import ForwardMode
+        from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_context import get_attn_backend
+
+        backend = get_attn_backend()
+        if isinstance(backend, HybridLinearAttnBackend):
+            backend = backend.linear_attn_backend
+        if not isinstance(backend, KDAAttnBackend):
+            return None
+        layer_id = self.attn.layer_id
+        conv, state, ids, cu, replayssm = backend.fused_kda_layer_state(layer_id)
+        if replayssm:
+            return None
+
+        mode = forward_batch.forward_mode
+        if mode.is_decode():
+            return self._kda_fused_decode(
+                hidden_states, forward_batch, backend, conv, state, ids, layer_id
+            )
+        # Strict EXTEND only: is_extend() also admits mixed/speculative/
+        # split-prefill batches, which need intermediate recurrent snapshots the
+        # final-state-only prefill kernel does not produce.
+        if mode == ForwardMode.EXTEND and forward_batch.spec_info is None:
+            return self._kda_fused_prefill(
+                hidden_states, forward_batch, backend, conv, state, ids, cu
+            )
+        return None
+
+    def _kda_fused_decode(
+        self, hidden_states, forward_batch, backend, conv, state, ids, layer_id
+    ):
+        from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_forward
+
+        # The decode kernel bypasses o_proj.forward, so it is only faithful when
+        # o_proj would return the raw TP partial (no SP reduce-scatter / decode
+        # attn-TP all-reduce). Fall back to native otherwise.
+        if get_forward().sp_active or self.o_proj.use_decode_attn_tp:
+            return None
+
+        from aiter.ops.triton.kimi_delta_attn import (
+            kimi_kda_fused_layer_decode,
+            kimi_kda_fused_layer_decode_supported,
+        )
+
+        m = hidden_states.shape[0]
+        args = (
+            hidden_states,
+            self.fused_qkvg_proj.weight,
+            self._bfa_w,
+            self.o_proj.weight,
+            self._bfa_f_b_w,
+            self.attn.conv_weights,
+            self.attn.A_log.reshape(-1),
+            self.attn.dt_bias,
+            self.o_norm.weight,
+            conv,
+            state,
+            ids,
+        )
+        ok, _ = kimi_kda_fused_layer_decode_supported(*args)
+        if not ok:
+            return None
+        if "decode" not in _KDA_AITER_DISPATCH_LOGGED:

+            rank0_log("Kimi-K3 whole-layer KDA: aiter fused decode backend active")
+        out = torch.empty(
+            (m, self.hidden_size),
+            dtype=hidden_states.dtype,
+            device=hidden_states.device,
+        )
+        partial, _, _ = kimi_kda_fused_layer_decode(
+            *args,
+            lower_bound=self.attn.lower_bound,
+            norm_eps=self.o_norm.eps,
+            output_tensor=out,

+        # policy; leave it to the native forward.

+            return None

+        # Only the no-intermediate-snapshot (final-state) path is eligible.
+        if metadata.has_mamba_track_mask:
+            return None

+        from aiter.ops.triton.kimi_delta_attn import (
+            kimi_kda_fused_layer_prefill,
+            kimi_kda_fused_layer_prefill_supported,
+        )

+        # Raw [q,k,v,g] + [forget-A | beta] projections, shared with the native
+        # prefill path; defer_f_b leaves forget-A un-projected because the fused
+        # kernel applies forget-B itself.

+            hidden_states, defer_f_b=True

+            gate,
+            forget_a,
+            beta,
+            self._bfa_f_b_w,
+            self.attn.conv_weights,
+            self.attn.A_log.reshape(-1),
+            self.attn.dt_bias,
+            self.o_norm.weight,
+            conv,
+            state,
+            ids,
+            cu,
+            has_initial_state,
+        )
+        ok, _ = kimi_kda_fused_layer_prefill_supported(*args)
+        if not ok:
+            return None
+        if "prefill" not in _KDA_AITER_DISPATCH_LOGGED:
+            _KDA_AITER_DISPATCH_LOGGED.add("prefill")
+            rank0_log("Kimi-K3 whole-layer KDA: aiter fused prefill backend active")
+        out, _, _ = kimi_kda_fused_layer_prefill(
+            *args, lower_bound=self.attn.lower_bound, norm_eps=self.o_norm.eps
+        )
+        # Native o_proj applies the (m, 1536) -> (m, 7168) projection and owns
+        # the O-projection TP reduction, identical to the native prefill return.
+        return self.o_proj(out)[0]
+
     def forward(
         self,
         hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
         positions: torch.Tensor,
         forward_batch: ForwardBatch,
         zero_allocator: BumpAllocator,
     ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        fused = self._forward_kda_fused_layer(hidden_states, forward_batch)
+        if fused is not None:
+            return fused
         defer_f_b = (
             self._kda_hip_fused_decode_ready and forward_batch.forward_mode.is_decode()
         )

@@ -0,0 +1,84 @@
+"""Fail-closed gate for the whole-layer fused KDA backend
+(``KimiK3DeltaAttention._forward_kda_fused_layer``).
+
+The fused path produces wrong results if it engages on a layer whose shapes /
+reduce topology the aiter kernels do not cover, so every miss must return
+``None`` and fall back to the native per-kernel KDA path. These cases guard two
+failure modes with no other coverage: the backend defaulting to inert, and any
+single layer-config precondition being silently dropped.
+"""
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+from sglang.srt.models.kimi_k3 import KimiK3DeltaAttention
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+# A layer config that satisfies the full static contract. Each test flips one
+# field to a covered->uncovered value and asserts the gate falls back.
+_GATE = KimiK3DeltaAttention._forward_kda_fused_layer
+
+
+def _attn(**over):
+    cfg = dict(bias=None, lower_bound=-5.0, layer_id=0)
+    cfg.update(over)
+    return SimpleNamespace(**cfg)
+
+
+def _layer(**over):
+    attn = over.pop("attn", _attn())
+    o_norm = over.pop("o_norm", SimpleNamespace(eps=1e-5))
+    cfg = dict(
+        _kda_fused_layer_aiter=True,
+        do_fuse_qkvbfg=True,
+        use_full_rank_gate=True,
+        attn_tp_size=8,
+        _bfa_w=object(),
+        all_reduce_fusion=False,
+        split_sizes=(4608, 1536),
+        _bfa_fa_size=128,
+        _bfa_b_size=12,
+    )
+    cfg.update(over)
+    return SimpleNamespace(attn=attn, o_norm=o_norm, **cfg)
+
+
+# (name, layer) pairs, each uncovered by exactly one field. Dropping the
+# matching guard in _forward_kda_fused_layer turns that case red.
+_CONTRACT_MISSES = [
+    ("do_fuse_qkvbfg off", _layer(do_fuse_qkvbfg=False)),
+    ("not full-rank gate", _layer(use_full_rank_gate=False)),
+    ("attn_tp_size != 8", _layer(attn_tp_size=4)),
+    ("no [f_a|b] weight", _layer(_bfa_w=None)),
+    ("all-reduce fusion on", _layer(all_reduce_fusion=True)),
+    ("wrong split sizes", _layer(split_sizes=(4608, 1024))),
+    ("wrong f_a size", _layer(_bfa_fa_size=64)),
+    ("wrong beta size", _layer(_bfa_b_size=8)),
+    ("conv bias present", _layer(attn=_attn(bias=object()))),
+    ("lower_bound != -5", _layer(attn=_attn(lower_bound=-4.0))),
+    ("norm eps != 1e-5", _layer(o_norm=SimpleNamespace(eps=1e-6))),
+]
+
+
+class TestKimiK3KdaFusedGate(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_inert_when_backend_not_aiter(self):
+        # Default (backend="native") / non-HIP: the fast path must never engage,
+        # so stock numbers are reproduced bit-for-bit.
+        layer = _layer(_kda_fused_layer_aiter=False)
+        self.assertIsNone(_GATE(layer, hidden_states=None, forward_batch=None))
+
+    def test_fail_closed_on_contract_miss(self):
+        # Each uncovered layer config falls back to native before any state pool
+        # is touched; a baseline miss would otherwise feed the kernel a shape it
+        # cannot handle.
+        for name, layer in _CONTRACT_MISSES:
+            with self.subTest(miss=name):
+                self.assertIsNone(_GATE(layer, hidden_states=None, forward_batch=None))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
